scope: Narrow read-only review of the fixed four-line retention child-prefix normalization and complete-module name-set checks.
observations: The normalizer recognizes one fixed parent line, one running-1-test line and one fixed child prefix completed by the parent's ok. More than one exact block cannot pass the complete-module branch.

After the single transformation, the complete-module path still requires exactly 174 success rows, 174 unique names and equality to the registered name set, together with the original 174/0/0/0/0 summary.

The source contains explicit controls for duplicate blocks, wrong child, missing block, failed child-shaped text, missing independent child success, missing/duplicate/foreign case and wrong summary. No such controls were executed by this review.

The selected-case prefix-plus-summary logic is pre-existing and is not strengthened by this normalization. This narrow review does not turn selected diagnostics into complete module or workspace qualification.
